verses.1: Do not take part in the deeds of the wicked; do not let your hands be involved with their evil deeds, so that you may not become witnesses to their wickedness.
verses.2: He shall not be a rival for those who are powerful, nor shall he tolerate those who oppress others. He shall not serve those who oppress others in any way.
verses.3: And do not become angry in disputes.
verses.4: For if your bow or your arrows are broken, he will restore them to us.
verses.5: For you will see your beloved lying under the weight of his burden. You will stop helping him. So, leave him alone and don’t bother with him anymore.
verses.6: Do not reject your father’s judgment in a quarrel.
verses.7: Let him be far away from the land of falsehood. Let him be pure and righteous. Do not kill him, for he is not an evil person.
verses.8: And do not take revenge, for vengeance will only bring about the destruction of those who are righteous.
verses.9: And you shall not press them; and you shall know the nature of those who are like foreigners. For you have lived in Egypt as foreigners.
verses.10: And in six years, you will sow your land, and you will gather your crops.
verses.11: And the seventh year shall be set aside, and it shall be abandoned. Your ancestors will eat from it, and the life of the field will be improved. Thus, it shall be used for your vineyards and for your orchards.
verses.12: For six days, you shall do your work. On the seventh day, you shall rest so that your strength and energy can be restored. Then your true son will be raised from the dead.
verses.13: And in everything I have said to you, you must keep them. Do not mention any other name of God. Do not listen to those who speak against it.
verses.14: Three legs will celebrate with me in that year.
verses.15: On the day of Passover, you must observe it for seven days. You must eat matzot as commanded by God on the day of Easter. It is on that day that you left Egypt. Do not look at anything else.
verses.16: And the harvest festival is when you gather your crops from the fields that you planted. It’s also a time to celebrate when you bring together all your crops from the fields at the end of the year.
verses.17: Three times a year, all of your memories will be remembered before the throne of God.
verses.18: Do not sacrifice on the altar of my blood offerings. And do not eat the meat of my festivals until tomorrow.
verses.19: At the beginning, in the depths of your land, God will bring His house. Do not defile yourself with milk from your mother’s breast.
verses.20: Behold, I send an angel before you to protect you along the way, and to bring you to the place that I have prepared for you.
verses.21: Guard him from his eyes, and listen to his words. Do not commit any sin against him, for His name is among his lips.
verses.22: For if you listen to his voice, and do all that I say, then I will remove your troubles and ease your suffering.
verses.23: For Malachi will go before you, and he will lead you to the Amorites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Canaanites, the Gebusites, and the Chittimites.
verses.24: Do not worship them, do not serve them, and do not do what they do. For they will be destroyed, and their places of residence will be ruined.
verses.25: And you shall serve the LORD your God. He will bless your fields and your herds. And I will take away the plague from you.
verses.26: Do not be barren and unable to conceive in your land during the years of your life.
verses.27: I will send my prophets before you, and I will destroy all the nations among whom you will come. I will give all your enemies over to you.
verses.28: And I have sent the locusts before you, and they will destroy the vines, the Canaanites, and the Hittites from before you.
verses.29: We will not abandon you for one year, so that the land may not become barren and overwhelming for you.
verses.30: Bit by bit, they will be removed from before you, until you possess and rule over the land.
verses.31: And I will take your land from the sea of Salt, from the coast of Philistia, and from the Jordan all the way to the river. For I will give you over to your hands those who dwell in this land, and you shall dispossess them from before you.
verses.32: Do not mark them and their gods as “holy.”
verses.33: They shall not dwell in your land, lest they deceive you. For you will serve their gods, and that will become a curse for you.
